name: Codebook Model (VQ-VAE)
definition: A VQ-VAE used to map images to a smaller discrete latent space (code space) and back to the image space. It reduces dimensionality from 128x128 pixels to 8x8 tokens.
summary: The Codebook Model (VQ-VAE) maps continuous data to a discrete latent space using a learned codebook, enabling efficient sequence modeling and significant dimensionality reduction.
